verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit reviews every PR automatically on open. It detects low-quality AI-generated 'slop' PRs, applies AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md as review criteria, and can block merges through its request-changes workflow. It also runs inside coding-agent loops such as Claude Code and ranks a cross-repo PR queue by risk. A hands-on user reports it catching bugs Claude Code missed, but another team dropped it for verbosity and false positives. Missing for 10: independent evidence of review accuracy and throughput at high agent-PR volume, and resolution of the false-positive reports.
